npc.salvage_specialist.flavor_text: I've stripped more claims than the Guild keeps records of. If the escrow ore is real, I want first look at it.
npc.depot_attendant.flavor_text: Everything that lands here is somebody's problem eventually. The bonded rows are my problem today.
step.mer_q1_contract.title: The Contract
step.mer_q1_contract.description: Sign the Guild's contract on Earth. The Guild gets first claim on anything recovered from the Mars site; you get the cutter that opens it. The first clause points at an old Wolf 359 claim.
step.mer_q1_contract.dialogue.guild_mast: The contract is short because long ones make people read them. The Guild gets first claim on the Mars site; you get the cutter that opens it. First clause: the Wolf 359 escrow ore that pays for the work. Sign, and I file the deed today.
step.mer_q1_contract.completion_flavor: The deed is filed and the claim is yours on paper. Clearance takes some weeks - the Guild's lawyers are thorough when the ore is worth it. They will call when the way to Wolf 359 b is clear.
step.mer_q1_contract.ready_message: The claim is cleared. Reach Wolf 359 b and recover the escrow ore from the caves beneath the listening post. The consortium knows the deed changed hands; expect them to contest it.
step.mer_q2_strike.title: The Claim
step.mer_q2_strike.description: Descend into the Wolf 359 b caves and work the Guild's abandoned claim. Consortium prospectors are already in the deep cache - clear them out and secure the escrow ore.
step.mer_q2_strike.dialogue.guild_master: The claim sat dormant long enough for everyone to forget who paid for it. The ore is in the deep cache - unless the consortium has decided a neglected deed is an invitation.
step.mer_q2_strike.completion_flavor: The raw ore is loaded into your hold - valuable, disputed, and useless until it is smelted. The Guild's only specialist for material this pure works out of Tau Ceti b, and the consortium has noticed whose hold it is in.
step.mer_q3_transport.title: The Smelt
step.mer_q3_transport.description: The ore is in your mission hold, unrefined and already hunted. Run it to the Guild's salvage specialist at Tau Ceti b. To the consortium, this cargo is not freight - it is their claim walking away.
step.mer_q3_transport.dialogue.salvage_s: So the escrow ore is real. Hand it over and I will fire up the smelter - assuming it agrees to run. Material this pure has opinions.
The smelter is running hot and the readings will not settle. Give it time.
step.mer_q3_transport.completion_flavor: The specialist feeds the ore in and goes quiet. The assay comes back impossible: stronger than anything in the Guild's catalogue, with traces that match no human mine. 'Give me time,' is all he says.
step.mer_q3_transport.ready_message: The smelt is done. The alloy is harder than any tool steel and it holds an edge like a rumor. Collect it at Tau Ceti b.
step.mer_q4_bribe.title: The Bond
step.mer_q4_bribe.description: The Guild has found a cutting rig worthy of the alloy: the consortium's own bore, seized when your deed won Wolf 359. It sits in the Depot's bonded rows while consortium lawyers contest the seizure. The bond fee is 8,000cr - raise it however you like and pay the attendant.
step.mer_q4_bribe.dialogue.depot_attenda: The consortium bore, row nine, still under contest. I cannot sell it and I cannot release it - but the bond fee keeps it fed and sheltered, and the fee is 8,000cr behind. Settle that and row nine opens. However you come by the credits is between you and your ledger.
step.mer_q4_bribe.completion_flavor: The fee clears, row nine opens, and the bore is winched onto the Guild's dock. The refit takes weeks - the mount must be bored and tempered to hold alloy teeth instead of consortium steel.
step.mer_q4_bribe.ready_message: The rig is refitted and waiting. The specialist has the smelted alloy at Tau Ceti b - collect it, then make for Vega.
step.mer_q5_calibration.title: The Survey
step.mer_q5_calibration.description: The refitted rig is useless without a cutting plan. A survey scout that scanned the Mars site during the Incident went dead near Vega; its recorder holds a stress map of the door - where the material carries strain, where a point force bites. The consortium guards the wreck. Take the alloy, take the survey.
step.mer_q5_calibration.dialogue.salvage: There is the alloy, loaded and lashed. It is worth more than the ore, the claim, and my smelter. Now it needs eyes: the survey recorder near Vega mapped the door's weak lines before the consortium killed the scout that made it. Bring the recorder back and the smiths will know exactly where to set the teeth.
step.mer_q5_calibration.completion_flavo: The recorder is recovered and the consortium leader is not a problem you will hear about again. The survey does not explain the door - it shows where it fails. The Guild's smiths will want time to set the teeth to the weak lines and true the drive to the load.
step.mer_q6_cutter.title: The Cutter
step.mer_q6_cutter.description: Return to the Guild Master on Earth. The bore is refitted, the teeth are set to the survey's weak lines. The cutter is ready to be collected - and the door on Mars is ready to be opened.
step.mer_q6_cutter.dialogue.guild_master: There it is. Consortium steel, Guild refit, Wolf 359 teeth. The survey gave us the weak lines and the smiths cut the teeth to match. We are not asking the door anything - we are taking it apart where it was always going to come apart. Collect your cutter. The Guild keeps its end.
step.mer_q5_calibration.ready_message: The smiths are done. The teeth are set to the survey's weak lines and the drive is trued. The cutter waits at the Guild on Earth.
